claim: The new DEFAULT-unwrap check requires resolvedValue to be an array, so it can never fire for the plain-object namespace-root case (e.g. `{ DEFAULT: '1rem' }`) it was added to handle; CSS `theme('text')` lookups for a namespace with only a bare value now fall through every branch and return `undefined` instead of the string value, since the equivalent unguarded array check that used to make this safe as an else-if has been removed.
